name: REM Electronics
old_description: REM specializes in sourcing and replacing obsolete or hard-to-find components, helping customers avoid costly downtime and keep production on track. With our expertise and commitment to continuity, REM is a trusted partner in maintaining efficient, uninterrupted operations.
about:
REM Electronics Supply Company, Inc. operates from Warren, Ohio. The business was started in 1955 by Robert E. Miller (known as REM) as a sales and service operation focused on the consumer market with TV antennas and hi-fi equipment.

Today the company functions as a full-service distributor and value-added manufacturer with 30,000 to 75,000 square feet of office and warehouse space. Its manufacturing capabilities span SMT and through-hole assembly, cable and wire harness assembly, box build, 3D printing and prototyping, R&D and design assistance, component preparation and modification, X-ray inspection, and RFID services. The firm also provides full contract manufacturing, testing, and distribution.

REM serves U.S. government agencies involved in defense and national security, as well as manufacturers, assemblers, and repair teams across the electronics sector. The company emphasizes a local presence in Northeast Ohio and Western Pennsylvania while supporting customers nationally.

The company highlights its specialization in sourcing obsolete and hard-to-find components to prevent production downtime, and it promotes U.S.-based manufacturing for tighter quality control, faster turnaround, and supply chain security. With 70 years in business and a manufacturing team holding over 250 years of combined experience, REM positions itself as a continuity partner for electronic component supply.
